notes.title: Release | New Items and Products | Achievements
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, cash register wizards! 🛒🧙‍♀️🧙[/h1]

It seems like a lie that it's been almost a year and a half since my supermarket was released in early access, but it really has.
During this time different features have been added, new items, new products, new ways of customizing the supermarket and even the possibility of opening a café inside the supermarket.

Thanks to everyone who took part in this adventure and gave feedback, especially on discord!

Does this mean that the game will no longer be updated? Not a chance!
I still have a few more things I'd love to add, including new achievements and modding to allow any product to be added to the game. In addition, optimizations will still be made and bugs fixed!

Sometimes it took longer than usual to release what I wanted, but overall, I'm quite happy with the result considering that I didn't have any outside help in the development apart from the support of the wonderful community in fixing bugs, translations and coming up with great ideas. Many thanks to everyone! 💖

notes.title: Supermarket Update | 31/05
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, cash register wizards! 🛒🧙‍♀️🧙[/h1]

First of all, I'm sorry for being "missing" for almost a month, but I had some other things that needed to be done, so unfortunately, I haven't dedicated the time I wanted to the development. I'll be back with consistent bi-weekly updates from now on. Expect a revamped employee system next, along with some new products coming to the supermarket!

Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/JZsQrn9HJK]Discord Server[/url] and help with bug reports, ideas, or even just to chat!

[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/ad439a62cee40d11e9e0f525282664390c901346.png[/img] Game Changes[/h1]

[h2]Customers[/h2]

[list]
[*] Customers now only enter a queue when they are close enough to the object they want to interact with. This should stop customers from being stuck around some objects while waiting for the queue to decrease. This was very noticeable once the player unlocked the second floor.
[*] Added a scroll bar to employees affected when changing the schedule of multiple employees at the same time.
[/list]

[h2]Employees[/h2]

[list]
[*] Employees will now check if the product they are placing on the shelf is the product wanted.
[*] Employees will no longer move to the store entrance when the save gets loaded.
[*] Added a new priority task list where the player can define the tasks the employee will do (lower priority, default, or higher priority) or not do.
[*] The UI on employee stats has new icons with tooltips.
[/list]

[h2]Cash Register[/h2]

[list]
[*] Products spawned no longer get destroyed if the player leaves the cash register. This means you can resume if you need to leave for some reason.
[*] If the player leaves the cash register after scanning the last product, it no longer stops the payment sequence.
[*] Employees can resume attending after the player leaves the cash register.
[/list]

[h2]Delivery[/h2]

[list]
[*] Delivery people's movement has been updated to avoid some wrong positioning.
[/list]

[h2]Fridge[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a configuration option to the fridge.
[/list]

[h2]Translations[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved some PT translations.
[/list]

[h1]🪲 Bugs Smashed[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed scale on the interaction key for gadgets and cloth shelves.
[*] Fixed Onion not moving at the cash register.
[*] Fixed an issue that was disconnecting players when some new product was unlocked.
[*] Fixed an issue where unlocking new products was not working properly when the language was Japanese.
[*] Fixed an issue where the wanted products assigned by the players were not saving properly. This was fixed both for shelves and storage racks.
[*] Fixed an issue where employees were not carrying the maximum products they could while moving products between storage racks.
[*] Fixed an issue where employees were placing products in the wrong assigned slot on the storage racks.
[*] Fixed an issue where delivery guys were placing products in random positions inside the storage rack.
[*] Fixed an issue where employees would carry “nothing” if the product they were supposed to pick from the storage rack was not available anymore.
[*] Fixed an issue where dirt on the floor had a weird metallic glow.
[*] Fixed an issue where the products that the player placed on the storage rack were not placed in the right assigned slot, resulting in two identical products assigned to two different slots.
[*] Fixed an issue where customers would get stuck if the player removed the self-service cash register while the customer was moving towards it.
[*] Fixed an issue with multiple dropdown lists where the last option was not visible.
[*] Fixed an issue where the enter/exit hours slider in bulk employee schedule change was not properly initialized with the correct open/close hours of the supermarket.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the update! More coming in the next two weeks!
🔥 Nero Games

notes.title: 11/24 - Gamepad support, bug fixes and beta branch!
notes.notes:
Greetings, cash register wizards! 🛒🧙‍♀️🧙

Today I'm bringing you a rework of the inputs and also support for gamepads!
This took more time than I expected, but I think it's in good shape to officially support gamepads.

I would also like to introduce a new beta branch. As some of you may know, I'm currently developing this game all by myself, and sometimes I rush some updates that haven't had enough testing. Some of you have been kind enough to ask how you can help. So I'm going to create this branch on steam that will give you access to the latest builds for testing!
If you are interested, feel free to read more at the end!

I'm also still working on the following:
[list]
[*] Character customization
[*] Product price customization
[*] Delivery and Warehouse services
[/list]
This should be in the game during the next big patch in December!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]New Features/Improvements[/h2]

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] General Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Halloween theme has been removed from the game. The items and furniture are still in the game!
[*] Updated game engine. Should fix some crashes.
[*] The input system has been reworked. Now you can remap things like the character's WASD movement.
[*] Updated the controllers section in the settings menu.
[*] Gamepad is now supported. 🎮🥳
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/1f13a01e70d17786b25077e19b126f2ebe69e69e.png[/img] Issues Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some translations.
[*] Fixed an issue where the delivery guy put the products on the wrong shelf..
[*] Fixed an issue issue where the large storage rack was not working properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could jump or punch while interacting with the cash register.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Gamepad 🎮[/h2]

From now on I'm officially supporting gamepads. No matter if it is xbox, playstation or even nintendo switch gamepad.
Everything should work properly for you to just connect your gamepad to the computer and just play.

There is a virtual cursor to interact with the tablet components, while also some buttons to speed up the process, like ordering x100 of some product at once, just like it was with the keyboard/mouse using CTRL and SHIFT while clicking on some product.

In the game there are also changes where you can just switch between keyboard and gamepad, the game will automatically detect the new inputs and adapt the game and interface for that gamepad.

Something that's missing that I'll be adding in the future is the icons for each gamepad. For example, the default interaction button in the gamepads is the south button, which is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/998254fae8d6ebef59e084d51d08506ca925b7e0.png[/img] for Xbox or [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/7e8888c8b1a2914b05ed96fd853b1b90cbb2e9ba.png[/img] for Playstation.


Also remember that you can reassign any button you want in the settings menu!
I hope to get some feedback from players who decide to give the gamepad a try. ❤️

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Beta Branch[/h2]

So you are interested in helping test new builds before they are released to the general public? That's great, thank you very much for your help!

You can access the beta branch in Steam.
Go to your library, right click on My SuperMarket and then Properties...
After that you should see a tab called "Betas".
All you have to do is type in "mysmbetatester" and click "Check Code".
This will unlock the beta branch, where you just need to press the new button and it will start installing the beta branch. In your library you should see the name of the game like "My SuperMarket [beta]".

[h3]How do I leave the beta branch?[/h3]
Go back to the same tab and in the first field that shows beta participation just select "None". The game will revert back to the normal branch.
In the future, if you want, you can simply select the beta branch again to test some new features!

[h3]Reporting bugs in the beta branch[/h3]
In order to keep this under control, I ask that you use the "beta-branch" discord channel to discuss or report games found in this particular release.

notes.title: 09/15 - Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
Greetings, Shelf Stockers! 🛒🍎

Today I'm bringing more bug fixes and two small additions to the game that will be expanded in the future.

Before the notes, there is currently a bug when loading your saved game that does not load everything properly and your store will be empty. No furniture, no products, not even lights.

I'm already trying to find the source of the problem and hopefully this will be fixed in this latest version (0.4.33).
If this happens to you, please don't exit to the menu, save the game, or even submit a bug report in-game. Close the game with ALT+F4 and send the save file directly to me via [url=https://discord.com/invite/JZsQrn9HJK]Discord[/url] or email to support@nerogames.pt.

I'm currently releasing new versions every few hours to get to the bottom of this.
Sorry for this problem! 😞

[hr][/hr]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] The engine version has been updated to the latest version. This should help with some random crashes that some players were experiencing.
[*] Some optimizations have been made to improve performance. This should be especially noticeable as your store grows.
[*] The navigation system is now loaded from a pre-generated file instead of being calculated at runtime. This will improve performance and also the frame drops when loading the game or even expanding the store.
[*] Added missing translations for the banking application.
[*]Reputation drop is now halved. This doesn't mean it's easier to progress, but it's easier to keep your current reputation without dropping too much if things get out of hand.
[*] Now there is a real bus stop in front of the shop! 🚏
[*] Thieves now move much slower and have a different animation than other customers. 
[/list]

[h2]New Services[/h2]
[list]
[*] There is a new application in the tablet called 'Services'. This will provide some services that you can hire to improve your store.
[*] The first service is 'Security'. With this service you will have 24/7 protection against thieves. Don't hit the cop outside... 👌
[/list]

Currently, I've planned two more services. One is a delivery service, where you will have to handle some delivery packages to be handed to the deliveryman.
Another is a stock management tool, where you will be able to define a minimum stock for each product and they will be bought when the stock gets below the threshold.


[h2]Staff Training[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now you can train your employees.
[*] You can choose which trait you want to train and the amount of time/money you want to spend. While the employee is training, he will be out of town 🏃‍♂️
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rain in the store? I called the plumber and he fixed it. 😎
[*] Fixed an issue where employees would get stuck against each other in the middle of the store.
[*] Money changes are now displayed in the bottom left corner in order instead of all at once.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could interact with the open/close button from outside the store.
[*] Fixed an issue with the store sound announcer after expanding the store.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player was disconnected when unlocking a store expansion.
[/list]

As for the second floor store expansion, I'm still working on it! I just need more time to finish it!
Thanks to all of you who continue to help improve the game! ❤️❤️❤️

I'll never get tired of thanking you all one more time for the amazing feedback you all give! Huge thanks ❤️

For those of you who haven't joined our  [url=https://discord.com/invite/JZsQrn9HJK]Official Discord Server[/url], you are more than welcome!

If you find any issues or bugs while playing the game, don't hesitate to contact me!
Also, for those of you who found a wild product cart (new future item) in the back of your store, I'm so sorry. It accidentally went through one of the daily patches. Hope you enjoyed it 😅
This cart will be added in the next update 😁.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]What's coming next?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Store second floor[/b] - It will be unlocked in a future small patch. Probably between this week and next week.
[*] [b]More functionality in staff[/b] - The staff is not even close to what is ideal. The next goal is to implement some way to train them to avoid firing and search/contract new employees, but also more complexity on their tasks.
[*] [b]More Furniture[/b] - New furniture is coming along with a new product cart I've been working on for the last week. You will be able to move multiple boxes of products in the cart. This will be used later for customer shopping carts ❤️
[*] [b]More Polish[/b] - Gonna spend some time polishing several things and fixing some visual issues. Expect new animations and interactions! And also a permanent solution for the thieves 😁.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]New Features & Balancing[/h2]
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Tablet Homepage[/h3]
[list]
[*] All applications will now display the unlock requirements on the tablet homepage. This should make it easier for new players to know when to unlock each feature.
[*] Hovering over the reputation stars will now display the current star percentage.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Banking Application (Tablet)[/h3]

This application will allow players to check some details such as:
[list]
[*] Current balance
[*] Daily income versus expenses
[*] Request/Repay loans
[*] Check loan details
[*] List of all transactions in the supermarket.
[/list]

Currently in the banking app is possible to obtain 3 different loans:
[list]
[*] $10.000 - 10% interest rate - 24 days to pay
[*] $25.000 - 12.5% interest rate - 36 days to pay
[*] $50.000 - 15% interest rate - 48 days to pay
[/list]

Probably in the future I'll add a feature where the player chooses the amount he wants and the days to pay and the bank automatically calculates the interest rate for that specific loan.

[hr][/hr]
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Construction Application (Tablet)[/h3]

[list]
[*] New application that allows players to expand their current supermarket space. Unlocked when you reach your second reputation star for the first time.
[*] Currently, you can expand your ground floor to double the size of your supermarket. This will increase the rent.
[*] New alert message when a player upgrades the store. Shows the new rent.
[/list]

Currently this is limited to the first floor, and there's not much to do, but I've been working on the second floor for the past two weeks with some surprises! 😍
Another thing this application will hold is the ability to customize the store. This means different walls, floors, colors, ...
Gonna leave a little gif here showing what's coming next when the second floor is available 😁.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/76087b39cc405905d2490eb8a483d9f7cd377f5f.gif[/img]


[hr][/hr]
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Bankruptcy[/h3]
Before, you couldn't really lose the game in any way. Even if your balance went negative, it would be okay because you would probably be able to make it back in the next few minutes.
This is something I want to keep in the game since the main goal here is for you to have fun and not to get into a fully complex management game.

Now, you will go bankrupt if your balance stays below zero for seven days in a row. If that happens, it's game over.
There will be new warnings when this happens and also when there are 3 and 1 days left for bankruptcy.

One way to combat immediate bankruptcy would be to take out a loan in the new banking app, but remember that this is only a temporary solution.

Short version:
[list]
[*] New bankruptcy scenario that happens when your bank balance is below zero for 7 consecutive days.
[*] New bankruptcy warning notifications.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Report bug in-game[/h3]

This will help me analyze your save file and get straight to the problem and fix it as fast as possible!
Please use this feature while you are in the game, describing the problem and how to reproduce it if possible!

[list]
[*] New option to report a bug in the game.
[*] The in-game main menu has also been reworked. It now includes this new Report Bug feature.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Customers[/h3]

Those nasty customers getting 25 pineapples, apples or milk are gone! 👌

[list]
[*] Fixed a problem with the customer's shopping list, where saving and reloading the game would add the basic products (like apples, pineapples, milk, ...) to the available products.
[*] Fixed a problem where some customers would get stuck in the self-service checkout.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Employees[/h3]
[list]
[*] Employees will now avoid tasks that others are doing. No more multiple workers interacting with the same objects and doing the same task over and over again.
[*] Workers will now find the nearest janitor's cart instead of a random one.
[*] Employees will show up on time. Even if they skip the night.
[*] (Temporary) Workers can now grab items that are out of reach. This includes papers or product bags that are sandwiched between items. This is a temporary solution, but in the future the plan is to let the player know that it's out of reach and they should take a look at it. This will also help with customers in the future.
[*] Thief chance lowered even more. New mechanism coming soon!
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Confirmation Dialogs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now there are real confirmation dialogs for some actions. For example, when you fire an employee, take a loan or even pay back the loan, you have to confirm the action. This should help to avoid accidentally hitting some button 😎
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem where some sounds were played even when the audio was muted.
[*] Added "Footsteps" audio type to the options.
[*] Fixed a problem where it was possible to hear the broom sound effect anywhere on the map.
[*] Fixed multiple objects not being taken into account in the audio mixer.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Others[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added on-screen message to warn the player to restart the game due to lighting when changing the quality setting.
[*] Increased lighting capacity on balanced settings. This should avoid running into these lighting problems.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where interacting with shelf near an employee would block all player interactions with all objects.
[*] Fixed bug where player/employee could place products of different types on the shelf if the employee changed their type.
[*] Fixed a bug where employees would get stuck if the trash can was sold when the employee was about to interact with it.
[*] Saved games should no longer show negative products on shelves!
[*] Fixed a problem where clients would get disconnected when opening/closing game settings.
[*] Fixed a problem where it was not possible to interact with the shop switch until the player opened the tablet for the first time.
[/list]

notes.title: Week 4 Patch Notes - Staff
notes.notes:
Greetings, cash register wizards! 🛒🧙‍♀️🧙
Now is the time to being recruiting employees to assist in the supermarket!

It has now been one month since the game was first released in Early Access. I would like to thank you all again for the incredible support you provided over the course of this month!❤️

You're welcome to join our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/JZsQrn9HJK]Discord Server[/url]
Make sure to follow [url=https://twitter.com/NeroGamesPT]Nero Games on Twitter[/url]

If you come across any issues or bugs while playing the game, don't hesitate to reach out to me!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]What's coming next?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Store Expansion[/b] - It's time to expand the store. This gonna be released in two separated parts, one where it will be possible to expand the store in the ground floor and next, different floors!
[*] [b]Bank Loan and Bankruptcy[/b] - One of the most asked features you asked is the possibility of taking loans. It's coming! Also need to introduce some kind of bankruptcy 😅
[*] [b]More Furniture[/b] - Expect a bunch of new furniture in the next big patch. In all categories!
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[h3]Staff Application (Tablet)[/h3]

New Staff application will be unlocked when achieving half your first reputation star.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/045af4206f35cf5b3fdc455a0cc0ee73e168e50b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/0a8756a59d10380104d519a16955e6b2bfdd95ac.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/0a8756a59d10380104d519a16955e6b2bfdd95ac.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/0a8756a59d10380104d519a16955e6b2bfdd95ac.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/0a8756a59d10380104d519a16955e6b2bfdd95ac.png[/img]

In this app you will find two tabs:
[list]
[*] [b]Recruitment[/b] - Where you can post job ads, spend money, and search for candidates. The number of candidates that apply is influenced by two factors: the amount of time or money spent advertising and the reputation of the store. Stores with a higher reputation will attract job candidates with better qualifications.
[*] [b]Employees[/b] - This is where you can find a list of all the currently employed workers. You can review task assignments, current progress, and schedules. You can assign a work schedule for each employee and task. In addition, you have the option to terminate an employee's services if you no longer require them.
[/list]

The current employee tasks are:
[list]
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/64aeeb57916c051b96ce5998e67ae7dcdf289748.png[/img] Restocking[/b] - Check the empty shelves and get the products restock. In first place, if some product is available in a storage rack and not placed in a shelf, the employee will try to get those first. If there aren't new products, they will try to restock the shelf with lowest product quantity.
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/01201198ea28b75fb3903c4f1b91431151d305f2.png[/img] Cleaning[/b] - While cleaning, employees will complete four tasks to keep the store clean: cleaning dirt from the floor, picking up papers, retrieving any bags dropped by customers, and emptying the trash bins.
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/76953968639ba1fa491ddf3b755d75e40dea0b96.png[/img] Cashier[/b] - The employee will go to one of the available cash registers and scan all the products.
[/list]


[h3]Employees[/h3]
Each employee will have three main stats:
[list]
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/1f13a01e70d17786b25077e19b126f2ebe69e69e.png[/img] Speed[/b] - Affects the speed of tasks like scanning products at the cash register or cleaning the store.
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/c4e56dc18493f5592e28814d050ef1226ecbf21a.png[/img] Attention[/b] - Affects the attention to details like the products on the cash register. This will make the employees scan the products correctly without missing anything. And don't forget, a perfect attendance at the cash register means a bonus tip 🧙.
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/3fc55a580e42b04df2a86deb3e04ae1b5a7b7dcf.png[/img] Motivation[/b] - Affects the overall performance of the employee. Less stamina and happiness will be consumed while doing the tasks around the store.
[/list]

Beside that main stats, there are two other stats that define how employees behave:
[list]
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/ad439a62cee40d11e9e0f525282664390c901346.png[/img] Stamina[/b] - Performing tasks consumes stamina. When this stamina gets too low, the worker will look for a comfort item (like a chair) to sit on and regain some stamina. The task being performed will be paused until the worker has recovered.
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/5d94c6d711cd9ffef83d3db20d2dd7a2b436d4dc.png[/img] Happiness[/b] - Overall happiness of the worker. For now, it's just a base stat that is consumed while working in the shop. If the happiness gets too low, you may end up losing the employee.
[/list]

Both these stats are recovered during rest or when the employee is off duty.

Would like to leave it here noted that the current system is a base for further exploration and will be improved over time. It is by no means finished.
Also, you can't really train employees at the moment. You will have to hire new employees with new stats.

[h3]Staff Comfort Items[/h3]
Now staff will actively seek comfort while resting. Items while in the chair will help increase the stamina recovery. More items will be added soon! 😁


[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/ed018cb5c45fbe4c4c889b3db118828c0c75e339.png[/img] Notifications[/h3]
New notifications have been added to let you know some store management important decisions:
[list]
[*] [b]Recruitment Started[/b] - Who started the recruitment and how much it cost.
[*] [b]Recruitment Finished[/b] - Recruitment process finished and how much candidates it found.
[*] [b]Employee Hired[/b] - Who hired who!
[*] [b]Employee Fired[/b] -  Who fired who! Can't fire your friends 👌
[/list]

[h3]Customers[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Better route[/b] - Customers will now look for the best way to pay for the products and leave. This means that if a new cashier is open or a self-service cashier is free, they will try to go to it.
This allows players to effectively run 2 or more cashiers at the same time. If you need to speed up the payout, you can go to a new cashier and see the queue of the older ones split into the new one 😍.
[/list]

[h3]Administration App[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Staff Costs[/b] - Now you can check the daily costs of all employees in the Administration tab. Are they even worth 🤔?
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the drop bags could be stuck outside zone or at store wall.
[*] Fixed an issue where was impossible to skip night after readjust the store schedule.
[/list]

[h2]Language[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed translations errors in german and spanish.
[/list]

notes.title: Week 2 Patch Notes - New languages and store administration!
notes.notes:
Greetings, cash register wizards! 🛒🧙‍♀️🧙

After 2 weeks of Early Access the development continues at a steady pace. Thanks again for all the support and feedback you gave!
Feel free to jump into the official Discord at https://discord.com/invite/JZsQrn9HJK

I'll probably start making some polls to find out what the community wants me to implement next, since this game is made by a one person and, you (the community) are the only ones who can give feedback 😁!

As for the new languages, if you found a bug in the translations and want to contribute, feel free to talk to me. I'll give you access to the translation sheets ❤️

[h2]What's coming up next week?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Staff[/b] - It's time for some helping hands in the supermarket. I know most players play with a friend, but I have to admit that the store gets crazy after a few days and to keep expanding it's almost an impossible mission.
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[h3]New Products[/h3]
Here are some new products that will be unlocked early in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/d1d6882f55894e508a1611ebded932858178fcfe.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/5d8f9a70918e8cb394e4b4e541fc58bedad6620a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/9a0c7ce56dc3e1e28c630b2fc5ff801bb36f59ec.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/9a767d6370f72e9f4dfdf1d0b626d3f5f60929f4.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/2461b18f453ce5f448af2a3b027725f6fcce0871.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]New Furniture Category - Electricity [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/565efccc024b563ae6b3b2add89a500330d48bda.png[/img][/h3]
[list]
[*] There's a new category under the Furniture app on the tablet. This new category will give access to lighting objects. Currently this is limited to four types of lights, but new furniture will be added in the future.
[*] When the player starts a new save, the default is two lights. Players with older saves will need to place lights! These two default lights on the ceiling can now be sold or moved 😁.
[/list]

[h3]Store Administration[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now the player is able to control when the supermarket is open or closed through the 'Administration App' or by interacting with the strange object on the wall inside the store. 🤔
[*] Now you can move any item while the store is closed. This will help players because now they don't have to buy multiple shelves or racks to move products to those new shelves and racks. Just close the store when you want, move the object, open the store again! 
[*] Players who run a 24-hour shop will find that customer traffic is lower at night than during the day (just like in real life).
[/list]

[h3]Administration App[/h3]
[list]
[*] New 'Administration App' on the tablet will be unlocked at the end of the first day (tutorial).
[*] The app provides settings to manage the store schedule, such as opening or closing the store at any time. If the store is closed while customers are inside, it will switch to "Closing Soon" state and refuse new customers. After all customers inside have left, the store automatically switches to Closed.
[*] In this app you will also find the running costs of the supermarket. This will provide the current rent and electricity costs. as well as future costs and expansion (future release).
[/list]

[h3]Reputation[/h3]
Previously, the reputation was given when the store closed every 17 hours. Since the player can now open/close the shop whenever they want, reputation is now given when customers leave the shop. Reputation is increased/decreased based on the player's happiness and also the amount of products they bought compared to the products they wanted.

[h3]Languages[/h3]
New languages have been added (may contain errors):
[list]
[*] Chinese Simplified (zh)
[*] French (fr)
[*] German (de)
[*] Italian (it)
[*] Japanese (ja)
[*] Russian (ru)
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the sky that was causing players to get disconnected when they reloaded the game.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The interface of moving objects has been updated.
[*] The tutorial tasks have been updated to better reflect the new administration features.
[/list]

notes.title: 07/26 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Greetings, Shelf Stockers! 🛒🍎🍎

Here I am to bring you more bug fixes and improvements!
Thank you all for your feedback, all suggestions are welcome and I'll take note of each one! ❤️
I'm currently focusing on fixing the bugs to get things stable and playable this first week before moving on to new stuff! If you have any ideas don't hesitate to jump into discord and help improve the game 😁!
Official Discord Server: https://discord.gg/JZsQrn9HJK


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Player - Fixed an issue where a player could grab two trash papers or product bags in a single animation. This was causing problems and possible disconnects.
[*] Player - Fixed an issue where the player could spam the <Interact> key to keep the animation looping when grabbing something.
[*] Player - Fixed an issue where the player could interact with bags/trash at the same time as shelves or racks.
[*] Player - Fixed an issue where if the player interacted with an object too quickly, the interaction ring would get stuck permanently in the center of the screen.
[*] Saving System - Now the store will properly save every hour (or when night is skipped) when the store is closed. It doesn't save when the store is open, but that will change soon!
[*] Drop Bags - Fixed an issue where players couldn't grab the bag from the ground even after reloading the game.
[*] Drop Bags - Fixed an issue where drop bags would contain the wrong amount of items.
[*] Storage Rack - Fixed issue where connected client players would be disconnected when trying to place items that didn't fit on that specific storage rack.
[*] Rain - Fixed an issue where all clients were disconnected when rain started in a consecutive loaded game.
[*] Reputation - Fixed an issue where daily reputation would be greater than 2.5%. This will be fixed soon when players start opening/closing the store whenever they want.
[*] Skip Night - Fixed an issue where the server-side player would get stuck without being able to move.
[*] Networking - Fixed other minor network sync issues between clients that were causing disconnects.
[/list]


[h2]Game Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Floor Dirt - After some more testing and player feedback, the drop in chance from the previous version was probably too much. The chance has been increased slightly.
[*] Drop Bags - Players can now grab multiple bags from the ground without the 30 item limit.
[/list]
